summary: Add BOT_HOLIDAYS to the scope for reading and privately displaying the published Thai financial-institutions holiday calendar. This does not authorise any other BOT product, does not authorise caching (the BOT retention rule is not established), and never substitutes for a US exchange calendar.
authorised_purposes: read the published financial-institutions holiday calendar
display the calendar privately on the owner Dashboard with source and date
private derived use (for example scheduling Thai banking operations)
not_authorized: retaining a cached copy (BOT retention rule not established)
using Thai banking holidays as US exchange holidays

obligations: the provider may change or limit the service
